_comment: Ordered list of images for the Couples & Engagement gallery. Files live in public/images/couples/. Naming: couples-01-short-description.jpg. EMPTY UNTIL SELECTED.
_selectionGuidance: Lead with interaction — walking, laughing, looking at each other — rather than a formal facing-camera portrait, since the page explicitly promises chemistry over posed romance. Include at least one detail frame (rings, hands) and one image of a couple who read as comfortable rather than intensely affectionate, so camera-shy couples can see themselves here.
